name: nft-jump-returns-then-drop
description: the user chain matches nothing and returns, so the later drop decides
setup: nft add chain inet f out "{ type filter hook output priority 0; policy accept; }"
nft add chain inet f sub
nft add rule inet f sub ip daddr 10.9.9.9 accept
nft add rule inet f out jump sub

action.spec: nft add rule inet f out ip daddr 10.5.5.2 drop
